title: Dustwind Cave

[[File:Dustwind_Cave.jpg|thumb|Dustwind Cave]]
'''Dustwind Cave''' in [[Durotar]] is a haven for the exiled members of the [[Burning Blade]] clan. It is located atop the cliffs of [[Razorwind Canyon]], just northeast of [[Razor Hill]].
